task:
URGENT production defect: system name autocomplete times out on V3 (every /api/local/autocomplete call returns 503 after ~15 s).

Owner-run read-only diagnosis on production (2026-11-01, edfinder_v3_phase4c_full_20260827_r5, PostgreSQL 18):
- `systems` resolves to v3_gen_phase4c_full_20260827_r5.systems (198,523,840 rows). Its only indexes are systems_pk (id64), systems_macro_grid_idx and systems_grid_viewport_idx. There is no name index, so local_db_autocomplete in apps/api/src/local_search.py (`WHERE lower(name) LIKE $1 ORDER BY name LIMIT 10`, plus a `name % $1` trigram fallback) plans a Parallel Seq Scan over all rows and hits the 15 s statement timeout. The V2-era sql/011 text_pattern_ops index never existed on V3. (A second schema v3_gen_phase4b_a.systems has 1 row; ignore it.)
- Database collation is en_US.utf8, so a default-opclass btree on lower(name) cannot serve LIKE 'prefix%'.
- v3_derived.system_search already has system_search_name_lower btree (derived_generation_id, lower(name)) — default opclass, so also unusable for LIKE prefix — plus system_search_pkey, system_search_position_gist and system_search_region.
- No role-level search_path settings exist (pg_db_role_setting empty); check how the API connection resolves `systems` (connection init / DSN options / pool setup) and keep the new query fully schema-qualified.

Fix (follow the existing governed V3 migration conventions used by migrations 019-022: registration in the migration ledger/identity, target authority transition registration in deploy/v3-production/target-authority.json, contract tests that pin the reachable migration sets, docs/operations/v3-production-schema-migration.md):
1. New migration sql/v3/migrations/023_v3_system_search_name_prefix_index.sql creating `system_search_name_prefix` ON v3_derived.system_search (derived_generation_id, lower(name) text_pattern_ops). The table only changes when a derived generation is built/purged, so a non-concurrent CREATE INDEX (SHARE lock: reads continue) inside the governed apply transaction is acceptable if the migration runner is transactional; state the expected build time/disk for ~198.5M published rows (plus any other generations' rows still present) and set the statement/lock timeouts the runner needs, following how earlier long migrations bounded themselves. Do not drop system_search_name_lower in this migration. Make the migration idempotent where the conventions require it.
2. Rewrite local_db_autocomplete to read v3_derived.system_search for the currently published derived generation (resolve it the same way the V3 Finder search routes do; fail closed with the existing 503 problem response if no generation is published), with `derived_generation_id = $1 AND lower(name) LIKE $2` (escape %, _ and \ in user input) and LIMIT a small bounded candidate set, then order by name in Python and return at most 10. Remove the trigram fallback (no trigram index on V3). Return the same response shape (name, id64 as before, x/y/z from position_ly, galaxy_region_id, record).
3. Tests: a PostgreSQL 18 test (tests/*_postgres.py pattern, disposable DB, gated by EDF_DB_TESTS_REQUIRED like the existing ones) that creates the V3 schema through the real migrations, seeds a published generation with names including mixed case, spaces, hyphens and LIKE metacharacters, asserts correct prefix results, that `%`/`_` input is literal, the 2-character minimum, the no-published-generation 503, and that EXPLAIN of the exact SQL uses system_search_name_prefix (Index Scan / Index Only Scan, no Seq Scan) with enable_seqscan left on. Unit tests for escaping. Update any test that pins the old autocomplete SQL.
4. Docs: CHANGES.md entry and a short note in docs/operations/v3-production-schema-migration.md for applying 023 (plan run must list pending exactly [023]). Do not apply anything to production.
Run the full Python unit suite and pnpm check in apps/web if any generated types change.
